title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
summary_full: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.
summary_public: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.
